crime: {WITCH_NAME}'s first friend inside was a girl who had grown up in her father's pool hall. Every evening, the two of them played pool in the recreation room until lockup.
Every night, her Magic carried her into her friend's dream, where they met again at that pool hall. Each morning in the dining hall, they told the table the same night, down to every shot.
Then one evening, chalking her cue at the pool table, the girl asked her to come only on Sundays. "I wake up tired. Let me just sleep."
Back home, {WITCH_NAME}'s best friend had called her every night, then only on Sundays. That spring, she kept the phone by her pillow every Sunday. The calls came on fewer Sundays, then on none.

One weeknight before lockup, she followed the girl down and found her asleep, alone in her single cell. {WITCH_NAME} did not step into her dream. She pressed the pillow over her face until her friend went still, drew the blanket up to her chin, turned her to face the wall, and was back in her own cell by lockup.
The next morning at breakfast, she told the table last night's dream, as she did every morning: the pool hall, until the bell woke them both.
At twenty past six, a prisoner went to fetch the girl for breakfast and found her under the blanket, dead, her face to the wall.
In the trial court, the prisoners took it that she had woken at the bell and been smothered afterward, while {WITCH_NAME} sat among them at breakfast.
But in that cell, a prisoner had tried to loosen the dead girl's fingers from the hem of the blanket. They were cold, and too stiff to open.
The prisoners realized the girl had been dead since before lockup. No sleeping girl had shared that dream; {WITCH_NAME} had made it up.
fields.epitaph: The last dream she told of the two of them was the only one she dreamed alone.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Waits for Sunday's Call
execution: The execution stand raises an iron wall telephone, taller than a girl. Its iron cord is looped around her throat, and its receiver hangs high on the hook.

While the receiver hangs on the hook, the cord draws taut and hauls her off her feet by the throat. When the phone rings, the receiver drops to her ear and the cord slackens. Each ring comes farther apart than the last.
Then it stops ringing for good. She hangs from the cord beneath the silent receiver until she no longer stirs.

magic.name: Guest in Your Dreams
magic.text: She steps into the dream of any sleeper she thinks of, and both wake remembering it.
